claims.text: Tx = usually dapsone or sulfapyridine plus a gluten-free diet
claims.quote: Treatment is usually with dapsone or sulfapyridine and a gluten-free diet.

claims.text: After initial therapy and stabilization, most pts can stop drugs and stay on the gluten-free diet alone (may take months or years)
claims.quote: After initial therapy and disease stabilization, most patients can stop pharmacologic therapy and be maintained on the gluten-free diet, but this may take months or years.
